title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-harper-khan-2026-03-04
content:
Release Train Weekly - ORION (v1.8)
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner / Prep: Harper Khan (notes)
Attendees expected: Samir, Maya, Evan, Priya (prod), Luke (SRE), Aisha (security), Dev leads as needed
Meeting goal: quick go/no-go decision readiness, call out late blockers, align on migration windows and rollback plan

Quick status (TL;DR)
- Overall: on track for soft launch to Dedicated customers 2026-03-11; on-hosted rollout staggered.
- Critical blockers: two outstanding infra tickets impacting KV-cache warmup on quantized path (JIRA:INF-2345) and autoscaler flapping in staging (JIRA:INF-2399).
- Mitigations: hotfix branch ready for INF-2345 (PR 412); autoscaler mitigation is a temporary policy tweak (SRE) - need approval to push to staging today.

Go / No-Go checklist (quick scan) - mark: OK / AT RISK / BLOCKED + owner
1) Model artifact validation (checksum + sampling) - OK - owner: Maya Singh
2) Smoke tests (hosted + dedicated) - AT RISK (4 flaky tests on long-context perf) - owner: Samir Patel
3) KV cache warmup on quantized path - BLOCKED (INF-2345) - owner: Evan Ramirez
4) Autoscaler stability in staging - AT RISK (flapping when tail-latency spikes) - owner: Luke Wu (SRE)
5) Security review & keys rotated (KMS) - OK - owner: Aisha Rahman
6) Rollback plan / runbook verified - OK (runbook v2) - owner: Priya Kapoor
7) Customer communication draft (status + opt-in window) - OK - owner: Customer Success (Riley)
8) Observability: tracing + token-level cost dashboards - OK - owner: Observability (TBD)
9) Load test targets met for Dedicated pools - AT RISK (10% under throughput target at p90) - owner: Eng-Serving-Runtime (Maya)

Notes / Details / What to bring up in meeting
- INF-2345: summary - quantized execution path failing to prime KV cache on GPU when sequence length > 8. Repro steps included in ticket. Hotfix PR 412 adds explicit KV priming call in runtime. Need SRE signoff for canary (single dedicated shard) today.
- INF-2399 (autoscaler): observed oscillation after QPS spikes; temporary policy change to increase cooldown from 30s -> 90s. If we push to staging, watch for compaction backlog. Long-term fix in release branch but not safe to merge now.
- Flaky smoke tests: 4 tests fail intermittently in perf harness; initial triage suggests transient network jitter between test harness and staging cluster. Samir to re-run with adjusted timeouts. If flakes persist, add "known-issue" flag to release notes and move ahead for limited customer cohort.
- Load test shortfall: Dedicated pool qps at p90 is ~10% under target with current batch sizing for long-context prompts. Action: Maya to try alternative batching config (smaller batch, more threads) and re-run overnight. If not resolved, consider delaying full Dedicated rollout and proceed with hosted gradual ramp.

Action items (assignments and due dates)
- Evan: get PR 412 merged & canary deploy to one dedicated shard by EOD 2026-03-04. If blocked, escalate to Samir. (due 2026-03-04)
- Luke: apply autoscaler cooldown change in staging and monitor 4 hours, report anomalies to #release-train. (due 2026-03-04)
- Samir: re-run flaky smoke tests with adjusted timeouts; post results + logs. If still flaky, propose known-issue text for release notes. (due 2026-03-04)
- Maya: run alternative batching load test overnight; update numbers in tracker by 2026-03-05 morning. (due 2026-03-05)
- Priya: confirm rollback window and notify PS/CS about potential limited cohort plan. Draft customer comms for review. (due 2026-03-05)
- Aisha: quick security smoke for KMS keys rotation - verify all service accounts can decrypt after rotation. (due 2026-03-04)

Risks / open questions for execs
- If KV priming hotfix isn't safe to merge today, do we delay Dedicated rollout by 1 week or proceed with a smaller canary? Need exec guidance on tolerance for incremental customer impact.
- Is the tolerance threshold for autoscaler oscillation acceptable for hosted customers? Ops wants explicit signoff to change cooldown for today's push.

Notes to self (Harper) - prep before meeting
- Bring updated infra logs for INF-2345 (last 3 runs) and attach to meeting notes.
- Have the runbook link ready: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/ORION-release-runbook
- Bring list of canary customers (2-3 Dedicated customers flagged) and estimated traffic.
- If asked about rollback cadence: remind that rollback can complete within 20 minutes for Dedicated shard; hosted rollback may take ~45-60 minutes to fully sweep.

Post-meeting follow-up (template)
- Publish final decision + short rationale to #release-train and Confluence summary (Harper to publish).
- Update JIRA tickets with decision tags (GO / NO-GO) and link runbook steps executed.
- Schedule retrospective next week to capture lessons (owner: Samir).

Misc / scratch TODOs
- Double-check customer comms list: Riley to confirm contacts for dedicated-customer-1 and -2.
- Ask Product (Priya) if any feature flags need toggling for the hosted gradual ramp.
- Confirm observability alert thresholds are correct for new model (TBD owner).

End - ready for quick read in meeting (1-2 min summary).
